summary: Persisted startup plans are found again after profiling rewrites the configuration
details: The startup plan was saved under a fingerprint computed after profiling. DeepSeek-V4-Flash rewrites its CUDA-graph mode from FULL_AND_PIECEWISE to FULL_DECODE_ONLY during profiling, so the next boot looked for a different fingerprint and never applied the plan.
The plan is now saved under the fingerprint computed before profiling. A matching plan skips the CUDA-graph memory estimation pass, which re-prepares every b12x attention plan.
